import subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
names=[]
for raw in subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','-z','--untracked-files=all','--','results/']).split(b'\0'):
 if not raw:continue
 p=Path(raw[3:].decode())
 if p.suffix=='.json' and p.parent==Path('results') and Path('logs/runs',p.stem+'.meta.json').exists():
  d=json.loads(p.read_text())
  if d.get('_meta',{}).get('end'):names.append(str(p))
assert names
print('SCOPE: newly completed sealed result files; preserved unsealed quota-failure sources are not certified',flush=True)
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['python3','scripts/audit_provenance.py',*names]))
